messages:
Lina R.: Chasing overdue items from the cache-invalidation postmortem. Several remediation tasks missed their target. Need owners to confirm status and next steps. PMR: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/cache-invalidation-2026. Ping @Devon H. and @eng-infra-oncall.

Devon H.: I own action #103 (ensure cache TTL is reset after failover). I ran the fix in staging but didn't finish the tracker update. Test looked good. ETA to mark done: today 2026-03-30 EOD.

reminder-bot: Reminder: action #103 assigned to Devon H. was due 2026-03-24 and remains open.

Lina R.: Please paste the staging test log and commit hash so I can verify before we close. If this requires an infra maintenance window for prod, state that now.

Devon H.: Staging run snippet:
```
[2026-03-29T19:02:11Z] failover-start node-7
[2026-03-29T19:02:45Z] ttl-reset applied keyspace=search-cache
[2026-03-29T19:03:01Z] health-check OK
```
Commit: 9b7c2a1. No prod infra window needed for config toggle; I can ship during a low-traffic window.

PM Lead: We're past the remediation SLA. If this isn't in prod by 2026-04-01 please escalate to eng-infra leads. @Lina R. can you set an escalation if no prod run by 2026-03-31?

eng-infra-oncall: Understood. If you need a maintenance window I can request a small config slot tonight. Submit the maintenance ticket and tag me.

Lina R.: Filed maintenance ticket mt-794: https://redwood-internal/maint/mt-794 and added eng-infra-oncall. Updated tracker: https://redwood-internal/ai-tracker/pmr-623 (new target 2026-03-31).

reminder-bot: Update: action #104 (ops checklist) still open; assigned to Lina R., due 2026-03-26.

Devon H.: I'll schedule the prod toggle tomorrow 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC and post the run logs here after completion.

Lina R.: Thanks. Final note: when the prod run completes, paste the maintenance run link + merge commit into the PMR and mark it remediated. I'll run a short audit on Friday.

Devon H.: Roger. Will update with run link and close out. :thumbsup:
